messages:
marta: Heads-up — nightly eval alarm: LegalQA hallucination rate jumped from 2.1% -> 17.8% for model x2-quant8.fast-attn-v2.

eval-bot: alert: eval/nightly/legalqa/hallucination_rate > threshold (17.8%). breakdown attached in logs: s3://redwood-evals/nightly/179002

devin: ugh. Is this the quant8 kernel rollout from last week? I thought we only changed a memory layout for KV.

sara: I see correlation with examples > 1024 tokens in the test set. Short prompts look fine.

kevin: can you paste a couple of failing generations? even 1-2 examples to reproduce would help.

marta: example 1 (masked sensitive bits):

```
Q: Cite precedent cases for M-47 in jurisdiction X.
A: The court in State v. Harlon (1975) explicitly held that ... [invented case names and quotes].
```

marta: model is inventing case names + fake quotes. baseline fp16 x2 doesn't do this.

ryan: confirmed on my local repro: run with seed 42, prompt id 1293 from legalqa. quant8+fast-attn-v2 -> fabricated citations. fp16 with old-attn is fine.

devin: could be an attention alignment bug after quantized kernel change; if KV offsets shift for long contexts we might be reading wrong memory and producing unrelated tokens.

sara: Also noticed hallucinations start after the model re-enters a system prompt block in long conversation examples. Maybe delimiter handling is off with fast-attn-v2.

kevin: can you run this minimal script? `python tests/repro/legalqa_repro.py --model x2-quant8.fast-attn-v2 --example 1293 --seed 42` and attach stdout.

ryan: ran it, attached output. Full generation shows odd token repeats before jumping to invented citations.

marta: logs show KV cache length grows as expected but some values look NaN-ish in the quant int8 view — might be dequant decode issue.

devin: interesting. we recently changed the dequant table for q8 -> q4 packing for perf; maybe the table indexing is off for slices > 1024.

sara: repro steps:
1) run nightly eval subset with only long-context examples
2) compare logits at step 512 vs baseline
3) diff kv cache bytes

kevin: I'll run logits diff on tensorboard; if logits diverge before hallucination point, we can narrow to attention or feedforward.

marta: can we try a quick rollback to fast-attn-v1 for the quant8 build to stop the nightly alerts? ops: rollback would require rebuild but should be fast.

devin: ops, please hold on rollout rollback until we push a hotfix branch. I'd like to try a patch: revert the qtable index math commit (commit: 4c2a9f) in a feature branch and run unit quant tests + repro.

eval-bot: note: created issue redwood/infra#4125 linking logs and failing example IDs. Also flagged customer-impact=low (internal eval) but regression is real.

ryan: I can run the hotfix branch later today and attach diffs. If dequant fix resolves logits, we can promote.

sara: also add a quick eval guard: if hallucination delta > 5% for legalqa after a kernel change, auto-block rollout.

marta: +1 on the guard. For now I'm disabling the fast-attn-v2 flag in nightly so we stop noisy alerts.

kevin: assigned to me and devin to triage root cause. target: reproduce -> patch -> verify on nightly subset by EOD tomorrow.

devin: filing PR for revert of qtable index math, will include unit test that exercises >1024-token dequant path.

marta: thanks everyone. please drop any interesting diffs or logs into the issue thread. I'll ping legal-safety for visibility.

sara: FYI I ran a quick run with fp16 quantized copy (no fast-attn changes) and hallucination stays low. narrows it to kernel changes.

kevin: pulling perf numbers too; we saw ~6% perf gain with fast-attn-v2 — we need to weigh that against this regression.

marta: we'll prefer correctness over perf until fix is validated. good catch, team. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: update: nightly eval resumed with fast-attn-v1 flag disabled; next check in 12h.

ryan: will follow up with a repro gist and logs tonight.

marta: closing loop when PR merges + nightly passes. if anyone sees customer reports about fabricated citations, escalate to legal-safety immediately.
